original_query: 커널 선택 가중치의 기능적 의미를 평가할 때 정규화, 분기 제거, 단독 경로, 재학습 비교에 관한 선행 문헌은 각각 어떤 주장까지 뒷받침하는가?
english_query: When evaluating the functional meaning of kernel-selection weights, which claims are supported by prior literature on normalization, branch removal, forced single paths, and retraining comparisons, respectively?

required_conditions.english: Identify the operator or intervention actually studied, distinguishing token attention from convolutional kernel mixtures.
Distinguish frozen-system ablation or forced-path evidence from performance after retraining.
Identify what the cited study does and does not establish about the interpretation of selection weights.
